name: PTES Conservation Insight Grants (worldwide)
summary: Grants of up to two years for projects that generate scientific evidence to conserve endangered species, such as testing a conservation intervention, run by organisations in the UK, its overseas territories or non-high-income countries.

geography.label: The UK, UK overseas territories or any country not classified by the World Bank as high-income

reporting: Grantees submit an interim report at the end of each year and a full report with a one-page executive summary after the work is completed, using PTES templates.

status.quote: WE ARE NOW CLOSED TO 1st STAGE APPLICATIONS FOR THIS YEAR

deadline.quote: Pre-applications must be submitted by 23.59 (UK time) on Thursday 28th May 2026.

geography.quote: We only accept grant requests from applicants already working and established in either the UK, UK overseas territories or any country NOT classified by the World Bank as high-income.

access.quote: Stage 1 - Pre-application form. A short standardised form designed to reduce the workload for applicants.

window.quote: Last year we introduced a two-stage application process for our Conservation Insight Grants which will continue in 2026.

amount.quote: We award funds between £3,000 and £10,000 per annum up to a maximum total of £20,000.

reporting.quote: An interim report is expected at the end of each year.
